RERUN-DESTRUCTION-APPROVAL-QUEUES.decision: Found by remediation journey J13 (required journey R14b, permanent destruction), not one of the 119 audit findings. A destruction review opened on an ACTIVE record — the only kind the Destruction page can open — and approved could never execute: the lifecycle table has no ACTIVE -> DESTROYED edge and nothing moved the record to PENDING_DESTRUCTION, so EXECUTED always answered 409 DESTRUCTION_REVIEW_BLOCKED_BY_LIFECYCLE. Approval now moves the record ACTIVE -> PENDING_DESTRUCTION through the lifecycle orchestrator before the review is marked APPROVED (a refusal there refuses the approval); cancelling an approved review returns the record to ACTIVE; a hold still wins.
